_doc: What was SEEN of each petrol station (Google Maps aerial + Street View, look only, 2026-11-14: nothing traced, stored or shipped) that the data does not say: the station's type, a canopy where the UrbIS DSM has none, the shop, the car wash, the scheme (our OWN generic brand look, colours only resembling the real one). Geometry comes from the data (UrbIS DSM - DTM canopy blobs, OSM building=roof, UrbIS footprints, OSM points, the road engine), never from the imagery. tools/fuel/build_fuel.py reads it. Types: canopy (a free-standing canopy over islands), under (pumps along a building whose own overhang is the canopy: the UrbIS solid is drawn to the ground, so the islands stand outside its footprint, under a fascia band on its wall), kerbside (pumps in front of a house / garage, no canopy).

n349272406.name: Lukoil, Wolvendael / Dieweg
n349272406.seen: white flat canopy, ~1 m fascia with red chevrons at the ends, two clad columns on the centre line, dispensers between them, the shop (a convenience store) in the building behind, price totem on the corner, paved forecourt open to two streets (Street View Apr 2024)
